say:2:1311225001:0.text: I should go tidy up Her Highness' wardrobe...
say:2:1311225001:0.source_cn: ……该去为公主殿下整理衣柜了。

say:4:1311225002:0.text: Excuse me, could you help us get out of this illusion?
say:4:1311225002:0.source_cn: 你好，能送我们离开这个幻境，回到原来的城堡吗？

say:5:1311225003:0.text: It's been over a month since she last wore her favorite dress; she must be feeling quite down...
say:5:1311225003:0.source_cn: 殿下已经一个多月没穿过她最喜欢的那条裙子了，她心情一定...

say:7:1311225004:0.source_cn: 看来她仍然看不到我们……

say:9:1311225005:0.text: I heard the Archduke had two maids thrown into the dungeon just because they didn't take proper care of Her Highness' art supplies.
say:9:1311225005:0.source_cn: 听说大公昨天下令把两个女仆投入监牢，就因为她们没有好好...

say:10:1311225006:0.text: *Sigh* His temper is getting worse... I need to be extra careful.
say:10:1311225006:0.source_cn: 唉，大公的脾气越来越坏了……我可得更加小心才是。

choice_prompt:11:1311225006.text: *Sigh* His temper is getting worse... I need to be extra careful.
choice_prompt:11:1311225006.source_cn: 唉，大公的脾气越来越坏了……我可得更加小心才是。

narration:12:1311225007:1.text: You suddenly feel dizzy as the kaleidoscope of distorted images bursts open in front of you again...
narration:12:1311225007:1.source_cn: 你们感到一阵眩晕，万花筒般的扭曲画面又一次在眼前绽开……

choice:11:0:1.text: Please help us leave this illusion.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 送我们离开记忆幻境的城堡
